plan.text: After one year of service, Chipotle employees can buy company stock each quarter at 92.5% of the market price through the employee stock purchase plan.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Note 8 Stock-Based Compensation and Employee Benefit Plans
source.quote: Employees become eligible to participate in the program after one year of service with Chipotle and may contribute up to 15% of their earnings, subject to an annual maximum dollar amount. The ESPP provides a quarterly offering period to purchase our common stock at a price of 92.5% of the lower of the fair market value on the first and last trading days of each offering period.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001058090-25-000014), reported in thousands and converted to billions; they match SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed April 25, 2025, accession 0001140361-25-015614), percentages based on 1,347,974,989 shares outstanding on April 15, 2025. LEADER: Brian Niccol, former Chairman and CEO, left in August 2024. He is still listed among the 2024 named executive officers, but the proxy shows dashes for him and says it has no beneficial ownership information for him, so status is not-disclosed. The proxy also says his 2024 long-term incentive grants were forfeited when he left. HOLDERS: Vanguard's row is based on a Schedule 13G/A filed November 12, 2024 with no as-of date given, so asOf is null; BlackRock's refers to December 31, 2023, split-adjusted. GEOGRAPHY: Chipotle reports one reportable segment (U.S.); the other operating segments (Canada, Europe, international licensed restaurants) are below the reporting thresholds and shown as 'All other revenue' in the reconciliation. BUYBACKS exclude $74 million of tax withholding on stock-based compensation awards.
